<p>Thank you, Coach Saban for yet<em> another </em>outstanding reason to dislike some of our sec brethren. And while the Tide enjoys a well-deserved bye this weekend for rest and prep for the athens’ puppies, there are some decent sec match ups to watch in what we will call <em>mediocre bowls</em> …meaning the losers will be deemed “the dregs of the sec” and the winners will grant their fans the gift of being able to enthusiastically claim, “We are a pretty mediocre team, y’all!”… said no Alabama fan <em>enthusiastically</em>…ever.&nbsp;&nbsp;I’m speaking of no other than: the piggies playing the boogs in auburn and the florida lizards (not playing ferociously enough to be called gators this year) heading to starkvegas to face the ms st doggies. If you don’t believe that these teams have potential to play some mediocre ball check out this deal below at missus st for “flex tickets” and note the small print “eight tickets for $200…redeem for any game in 2024 season”?!&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="IMG_2267.PNG" height="640" width="296"></p><p>&nbsp;That’s a good Vandy football ticket deal but did not expect that of the bulldogs, and, bless Vandy, their winning streak came to an end this weekend. Don’t lose heart and keep up the good fight, Commodores.&nbsp;</p><p>Other sec business involves lsu facing another california team this season!? Y’all already lost to usc and now, in the same season, they have the bruins (basically brown bears) of ucla on their schedule as well?! With the recommended brown bear survival protocol being “if brown, lay down”…Saturday could be a grizzly day for lsu…we can at least hope for the same outcome the aubs experienced when they played the california hippy bears…play hard and lose!</p><p>Perhaps it’s not optimal sportsmanship to wish ill on our sec colleagues, but I’m not too worried about winning the <em>worst </em>sport award with tennessee in the league. Only the volatiles would kick an <u>onside kick</u> in the <u>first quarter with the score being 30–0 in their favor</u>!? And, granted, you cannot tell guys who rarely play to hold back when they go in, but is it necessary to continue to kick field goals until the end so the final score is 71-0? Gonna take it <em>back to the day </em>and let Fat Albert’s little brother <em>Russell</em> sum it up with his morsel of wisdom that stands the test of time to perfectly reflect the vols’ behavior, </p><p>	“<em>You’re like school in summer…no class.”</em></p><p>&nbsp;…Sooooo, okies, sorry your “welcome to the sec” opener is with our least gracious rep, ut this weekend. Hope you can keep it respectable – at&nbsp;least your sec initiation is in norman. Good luck with that one and <em>may all our least detested teams be victorious this weekend</em>! How’s that for <em>mediocre</em> sportsmanship!? </p><p>Everyone else – enjoy stress-free football on Alabama’s bye week, because next Saturday will likely provide enough stress to age us all a year (or 12). RTR!</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>
